summary.text: Marlene Terry is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 66, who assumed office on January 6, 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Terry has worked as an accounting clerk with BJC Healthcare.

paragraphs.text: Marlene Terry was born in St. Louis, Missouri.
Her career experience includes working as an accounting clerk with BJC Healthcare.
In the Missouri House, Terry was assigned to the Joint Committee on Education for 2025-2026.
Her 2023-2024 assignments were the Children and Families, Corrections and Public Institutions, Elementary and Secondary Education and Ethics committees.
